risks.title: Commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: 2025 presented a challenging backdrop with lower commodity prices that reduced upstream spending and impacted global revenue, declining 2% year-on-year despite strong digital growth (MD&A, Item 7) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Lower oil and gas commodity prices reduce customer capital expenditures and demand for SLB services

risks.title: Geopolitical uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: 2025 presented challenging backdrop with geopolitical uncertainty affecting operations, particularly impacting international revenue which declined 5% year-on-year, notably in Saudi Arabia, Mexico and Sub-Saharan Africa (MD&A, Item 7) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Geopolitical tensions can disrupt operations and reduce customer activity in key regions

risks.title: Market competition and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: Oversupplied oil market and competitive dynamics in oilfield services sector pressure pricing and market share (MD&A, Item 7) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Increased competition in oilfield services may reduce revenues and operating margins

risks.title: Technology and digital transformation execution
risks.score_rationale: SLB's growth strategy depends on successful deployment and adoption of AI and digital solutions; execution risks exist in developing and commercializing these technologies at scale (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Failure to effectively execute digital and AI initiatives could impair competitive positioning

risks.title: Integration of ChampionX acquisition
risks.score_rationale: SLB completed $4.9 billion ChampionX acquisition in Q3 2025; integration risks exist including operational consolidation, cultural alignment, and achieving synergy targets (MD&A, Item 7) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Acquisition integration challenges could impact profitability and synergy realization

risks.title: Liquidity and debt management
risks.score_rationale: SLB carries $9.7 billion long-term debt and $1.9 billion short-term borrowings as of December 31, 2025, requiring disciplined capital allocation (Balance Sheet, Item 8) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: High debt levels require careful cash flow management and may limit financial flexibility

risks.title: Upstream spending cyclicality
risks.score_rationale: 2025 saw amidst lower upstream spending a 2% revenue decline; international revenue declined 5% due to lower activity in key regions (MD&A, Item 7) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Cyclical nature of upstream oil and gas spending creates revenue volatility

company_description: SLB N.V. engages in the provision of technology for the energy industry worldwide. The company operates through four divisions: Digital & Integration, Reservoir Performance, Well Construction, and Production Systems. The company provides field development and hydrocarbon production, carbon management, and integration of adjacent energy systems; reservoir interpretation and data processing services for exploration data; and well construction and production improvement services and products. It also offers subsurface geology and fluids evaluation information; stimulation services to restore or enhance well productivity through hydraulic fracturing, matrix stimulation, and water treatment; and intervention services to oil and gas operators.
